Source: https://docs.example.com/gateway/troubleshooting#log-settings
Source Name: gateway-docs

The gateway reads these environment variables at startup:
Variable: GATEWAY_LOG_LEVEL.
Default: info.
Description: Sets the log level. Use debug to log every request.

The gateway reads these environment variables at startup:
Variable: GATEWAY_TRACE_API_CALLS.
Default: off.
Description: Logs every API call the gateway makes.

The gateway reads these environment variables at startup:
Variable: GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT.
Default: text.
Description: Sets the log format. Use json for log collectors.
